_comment: Cards we have deliberately decided NOT to implement, so set completion means
'everything we intend to build is built' rather than 'literally every card exists'.
This is a policy list, not a backlog. A card belongs here only when the reason is
permanent — the card needs a mechanic the engine will never carry (e.g.
physical dexterity). A card that is merely hard, or blocked on a feature we do plan
to build, stays a normal missing card and keeps counting against the set.
Card names are unique across Magic, so entries are keyed by name alone and apply to
every set that prints them (Contract from Below covers LEA, LEB, 2ED, 3ED at once).
Every entry MUST carry a `reason` that resolves to a sentence in the `reasons` block
below — the sentence is what the CLI, the API and the /set-completion tooltip show, so
an exclusion can never read as an unexplained 'we skipped this'. A missing or unknown
reason is a hard error, not a skipped card.
Consumers: scripts/card-status (CLI report) and scripts/gen-set-totals, which bakes
/set-completion view. Re-run `scripts/gen-set-totals` after editing this file.
An excluded card that someone implements anyway simply counts as implemented — the
exclusion only ever removes a card from the denominator while it is still missing.

reasons.ante: Playing for ante is supported, but this card's ante effect isn't implemented yet.
